method: Official PostgreSQL public documentation reads only; no provider account/API or recipient contact

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 transaction access/isolation
sources.observation: Explicit read-only and repeatable-read transaction properties bound the inspection; they do not define a general SQL sandbox.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 information/ACL functions
sources.observation: ACL inquiry/expansion exposes privileges, grantors/grantees and grantability; compare permissions instead of ACL display order.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 role membership catalog
sources.observation: Cluster-wide membership rows distinguish role, member, grantor and ADMIN/SET/INHERIT options.

sources.title: PostgreSQL 18 role/database settings catalog
sources.observation: Role/database defaults are shared cluster catalog state, including non-database-specific settings.
